title: Runs from an already halted configuration
statement: For any nondeterministic register program, oracle, input, predicate $G$, register valuation $v$, result value $r$, and natural number $N$, every choice word of length $N$ from the halted configuration $(\mathrm{none},v,r)$ leads to a halted configuration, and every earlier configuration satisfies $G$ whenever it is nonhalted.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic register program, oracle, input, and predicate $G$
A register valuation $v$, result value $r$, and natural number $N$
The initial configuration has no active state
